hazard_items: Discarded electrical appliance plastic casing and switchgear panel (E-waste hazard)
Active stray livestock ingestion of plastic waste and mixed leachate (bovine ruminal impaction & zoonotic hazard)
Heavy corroded steel rebar cage and broken timber debris (physical injury and puncture hazards)
safety_warning: CRITICAL BIO-SAFETY & PUBLIC HEALTH HAZARD: Stray cattle and goats are actively foraging in the open dumpsite, ingesting single-use plastic carry bags, multilayer laminates, and decomposing organic waste. This creates an acute risk of fatal bovine ruminal impaction, heavy metal accumulation in local milk/food chains, and zoonotic contamination. Additionally, heavy corroded steel rebar framework, jagged broken timber panels, and exposed e-waste switchgear present immediate puncture and laceration hazards to municipal sanitation personnel.
